versioning.convention: Product milestones, not public API compatibility. Major: new business workflow/module. Minor: added capabilities. Patch: corrections, maintenance and documentation. One entry per date; reset lower components when advancing a higher component. Dependency upgrades alone are patch releases.
versioning.current_release_note: The 9 October entry combines the committed rewrite correction with this implementation. Its changelog row starts as a draft until frontend health is verified.
